snippet.title: ORAE - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist ORAE on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5282240/ORAE
Join the ORAE Discord: https://discord.gg/6pWHvgtnyU

Explore a dense, interconnected world once inhabited by humans and souls. Find your path, solve puzzles, collect floppy disks and make friends to uncover this world's deepest secrets.

A demo will be available in early 2027.
